nodes.description: bool public initDone; one-time initialization guard
address public admin; controls admin handover
address public pendingAdmin; two-step admin transfer target
address public superAdmin; controls super admin handover
address public pendingSuperAdmin; two-step super admin target
sbControllerInterface sbController; external controller used for fees, rewards and vesting
sbEthFeePoolInterface sbEthFeePool; receives ETH mining/claim fees
sbVotesInterface sbVotes; vote accounting target for mined amounts
mapping(address=>uint256[]) minerMineDays; per-miner mining day history
mapping(address=>uint256[]) minerMineAmounts; per-miner cumulative mined amounts
uint256[] mineDays; global mining day history
uint256[] mineAmounts; global cumulative mined amounts
mapping(address=>uint256) minerDayLastClaimedFor; claim cursor per miner
mapping(address=>uint256) mineForVotes; balances mined only for votes
msg.sender; attacker controlled caller used for auth and beneficiary
block.timestamp; miner-influenceable time source used for day math
sbVotes.updateVotes(...) external call mutating vote state
fee = amount.mul(numerator).div(denominator); mul/div arithmetic on user amount
block.timestamp % 1 days and day-length subtraction; timestamp dependent weight math
init(address,address,address,address,address,address) public one-time wiring of dependencies and admins
acceptSuperAdmin() pending super admin confirms takeover
serviceMinMined(address) view; checks service minimum mining via _minMined
minerMinMined(address) view; checks miner minimum mining via _minMined
mine(uint256) payable; pulls tokens, charges ETH fee, updates mining records and votes
mineFor(address,uint256) external; controller-only mining on behalf of a miner
unmine(uint256) payable; charges fee, updates records then returns tokens
mineForVotesOnly(uint256) public; locks tokens only for vote weight
getMinerDayLastClaimedFor(address) view; derives claim cursor fallback
claimAll() payable; claims all vested rewards for msg.sender
claimUpTo(uint256) payable; claims rewards up to a day and forwards ETH fee first
getRewardsDueAll(address) view; computes due rewards to current day
getRewardsDueUpTo(uint256,address) view; computes due rewards up to a day
_getMinerMineData(address,uint256) internal view; loads per-miner arrays and delegates to _get
_getMineData(uint256) internal view; loads global arrays and delegates to _get
_find(...) internal pure; binary search over mining day array with add/sub index math
_update(...) internal; mutates storage arrays for mine/unmine with timestamp weighting
_claim(...) internal; computes rewards, charges fee, deposits ETH and requests rewards
_getRewardsDue(...) internal view; loops days and pro-rates controller rewards
_getCurrentDay() internal view; derives current day from block.timestamp
_minMined(address,uint256,uint256) internal view; verifies minimum mining history
